question: Why did APAC's completed revenue fall so much more than other regions' from Q2 to Q3 2025?
plan: Calculate the quarter-over-quarter revenue growth/decline percentage from Q2 2025 to Q3 2025 for all regions to confirm and size the discrepancy.
Break down APAC's revenue decline from Q2 to Q3 2025 by product categories or top product lines to identify specific product drivers.
Break down APAC's revenue decline from Q2 to Q3 2025 by customer segments or specific major countries/markets within the region to isolate geographic or customer-specific factors.

sql_attempts.sql: SELECT r.region_name, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2025-04-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-07-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) ELSE 0 END) AS q2_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-10-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) ELSE 0 END) AS q3_revenue, (SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-10-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2025-04-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-07-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2025-04-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-07-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS q_o_q_pct_change FROM regions AS r JOIN customers AS c ON r.region_id = c.region_id JOIN orders AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY r.region_name ORDER BY q_o_q_pct_change ASC LIMIT 500
